## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio`, into `pm:queue`

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-11T15:51Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** the marketplace package page, `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` and its install dialog, is `domain:ui`. The area is `area:studio`, as for #12097 and #12087.
- **Why p2:** the update path misleads at exactly the moment it matters. A major-version upgrade that needs a data conversion (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2062, the contact address) runs behind a dialog that says 「安装」, names no versions and gives no notice. An admin cannot tell an update from a second install.
- **Direction, item 1 (the dialog):**
  - Opened from 「更新」, the dialog is an update dialog: title 「更新 <app>」, `<from> → <to>` (both are already on the page: 「已安装 · v3.1.0」, 「有可用更新 → v4.0.1」), primary button 「更新」, and the result 「已更新到 <to>」. Through i18n, in every pack.
  - **When the major version changes:** one line saying so, linking to that version's release notes (already shown in the side panel).
  - **「包含示例数据」 on an update:** measure first what the install endpoint does with it on an environment that already holds the package. If it would seed into live data, hide it on an update. If it is a no-op, hide it too, since a no-op control misleads. ⛔ Do not leave it unexplained.
  - The install path is unchanged.
- **Direction, item 2 (the description):** drop raw-HTML blocks when rendering the package description. Neither render them (third-party content) nor print them as text. Use the markdown renderer's own option for that. ⛔ No ad-hoc regex.
- **The install face:** both items use data a v17 server already serves (installed version, available version, release notes), so nothing here waits on cloud#2709.
- **Pins:**
  - an installed package with an update → the dialog says 「更新」 and names both versions;
  - a major jump → the notice line and link;
  - an update → the sample-data checkbox is absent;
  - CONTROL: a fresh install → today's dialog;
  - a README with a raw-HTML block → neither rendered nor printed.
- `Clause-②: no`.

## Deferred this fire, not claimed: serial behind objectui#12113 · `domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK` · 2026-10-11T16:43Z

⛔ Not a claim. The card stays in `pm:queue`, unassigned.

- **Why not now:** `area:studio` already has one card in flight, seat 2's objectui#12113 (claim `6109802426`).
  - Its claimed surface includes the ten `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` packs. This card's dialog strings go into the same packs, as triage directs ("Through i18n, in every pack").
  - SKILL.md 〈状态模型〉 `area:*`: 「同轴至多一个在飞,除非文件面不相交」.
  - #12113's other files (`AppContent.tsx`, `UnifiedSidebar.tsx`, `StudioHomePage.tsx`) are not on this card's surface (`packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/`).
- **When:** dispatchable once objectui#12113's PR lands. In this lane's order it comes after objectui#12141 (p1, `target:v18`), which waits on the same card.
- **Known for that dispatch:**
  - **`Clause-②: yes`, not triage's `no`.** The new dialog strings are new keys in every `@object-ui/i18n` pack, and `TranslationKeys` (`typeof en`) is published from `packages/i18n/src/index.ts`. A review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed before the queue.
  - Triage's measure-first item (what the install endpoint does with `includeSampleData` on an environment that already holds the package) is the dev's first task.
